description: Forge fearsome dragon names from draconic syllables, each crowned with a title epithet like “the Ashwing”.

faqs.a: Yes — with 24 fire-themed roots, 16 cores, and 20 endings plus 24 titles, the combinations run into the hundreds of thousands.
The title epithet is a dramatic honorific (like “the Embermaw”) that follows the dragon's name — toggle it off for bare names.
Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Choose whether to include a title epithet.
Pick how many names to generate.
Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.
title: Dragon Name Generator
